content.text:
Under the Quillbrook rules, you had to pay the deposit and the whole hire charge in full on 2 October 2025, the day your booking was accepted.

Your booking was accepted 10 days before the event. That is fewer than 14 days ahead, so `hall-fees.md` section 6.3 applies: "Bookings made fewer than 14 days ahead require full payment at acceptance."

The normal deadlines don't apply to your booking:
- **Booking deposit (6.1):** normally due within seven calendar days of acceptance, which would have been 9 October 2025.
- **Remaining hire charge (6.2):** normally due 14 calendar days before the event, which would have been 28 September 2025. That was before your booking was accepted.

If the event serves alcohol, the £100 damage deposit is also required (section 5.2). It is separate from the £30 booking deposit. The rules don't give a separate deadline for it, so I'd assume it is due with the full payment.

The later fee changes in `hall-changes.md` don't alter section 6. The `hall-fees-archive.md` file has older deadlines (seven days before the event), but it is not the governing version.
